en: The image shows a vintage black-and-white postcard depicting an outdoor stage or pavilion labeled 'CASINO FRANÇAIS.' The structure is decorated with flags and drapery. In front of the stage, there are rows of empty chairs set up, suggesting a public event or performance. The postcard is titled 'EXPOSITION INTERNATIONALE D'ATHÈNES' and also bears the words 'CASINO FRANÇAIS.' There is a watermark from www.elia.org.gr.
